question: Find the value of 5 + 5 of 5 ÷ 5 - 13 ÷ 5 - 2 of 3 ÷ 3.
solution:
**Given:**

5 + 5 of 5 ÷ 5 - 13 ÷ 5 - 2 of 3 ÷ 3

**Concept used:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/694d0d67bc14effd3a3679b70b4d77edef851107a6a53b64ea488e47e4c2bef5.png] **

**Calculation:**

5 + 5 of 5 ÷ 5 - 13 ÷ 5 - 2 of 3 ÷ 3

⇒ 5 + 25 ÷ 5 - 13 ÷ 5 - 6 ÷ 3

⇒ 5 + 5 - 13/5 - 2

⇒ 10 - 13/5 - 2

⇒ frac{50 - 13-10}5

⇒ 27over 5

**∴ Required answer is 27over 5.**
